Hi Karan! I’m not able to access real‑time flight data directly, but here’s what you can do to check the status of your Indigo flight (ticket number IND4567):

1. **Indigo’s Official App / Website**  
   - Open the Indigo app or visit [indigo.in](https://www.indigo.in).  
   - Go to the “My Bookings” section and enter your ticket number (IND4567) or PNR.  
   - The app will display the current status, gate information, and any updates.

2. **Flight Tracking Websites**  
   - Visit sites like [FlightAware](https://flightaware.com), [FlightRadar24](https://www.flightradar24.com), or [FlightStats](https://www.flightstats.com).  
   - Enter the flight number (e.g., *AI123* if that’s the flight code) or your PNR to see live tracking.

3. **Contact Indigo Customer Support**  
   - Call Indigo’s customer care at **1800-103-103** (for domestic flights).  
   - Provide your ticket number (IND4567) and they’ll give you the latest status.

4. **Check Your Email / SMS**  
   - Indigo usually sends automated updates via email or SMS if there are any changes.  
   - Look for a message from “Indigo Airlines” with your booking reference.

If you’re near the airport, you can also check the departure boards or ask at the airline’s counter. Let me know if you need help interpreting any of the information you find!
